expr: (let allIncreasing := lengthOfLIS_postcond.subsequences nums |>.filter (fun l => lengthOfLIS_postcond.isStrictlyIncreasing l); (((allIncreasing.map List.length).foldl max 0 : Nat) : Int))

lemmas.name: sub_nil24
lemmas.proof:
by intro xs
  induction xs with
  | nil => simp [lengthOfLIS_postcond.subsequences]
  | cons a t ih => simp only [lengthOfLIS_postcond.subsequences]; exact List.mem_append.mpr (Or.inl ih)

lemmas.name: lis24
lemmas.statement: ∀ (nums : List Int) (h : lengthOfLIS_precond nums), lengthOfLIS_postcond nums (let allIncreasing := lengthOfLIS_postcond.subsequences nums |>.filter (fun l => lengthOfLIS_postcond.isStrictlyIncreasing l); (((allIncreasing.map List.length).foldl max 0 : Nat) : Int)) h
lemmas.proof:
by intro nums h
  unfold lengthOfLIS_postcond
  intro allIncreasing
  have hnil : [] ∈ allIncreasing := List.mem_filter.mpr ⟨sub_nil24 nums, by simp [lengthOfLIS_postcond.isStrictlyIncreasing]⟩
  have hs := Refine.maxlen_spec allIncreasing hnil
  exact ⟨by simpa using hs.1, by simpa using hs.2⟩
